Report Designer: Pentaho's desktop report authoring tool (PRD). Reports are saved as .prpt files and can be published to the Pentaho Server.
band: A horizontal section of the report canvas (report header, group header, details, footers). Elements are placed inside bands.
data source: Where a report's data comes from - JDBC, Metadata, Pentaho Analysis (Mondrian), XML, tables, and more.
JDBC: Java Database Connectivity - the standard Java API Report Designer uses to connect to relational databases.
query: The statement (usually SQL) a data source runs to produce the rows a report consumes.
group: A report section that gathers detail rows sharing a value (e.g. one section per Product Line), with its own header and footer bands.
formula: An OpenFormula expression (=IF(...)) attached to an element or style property, evaluated per row at run time.
function: A predefined calculation (page number, running sum, item count) added to a report from the Data tab.
conditional formatting: Styling that changes based on data values - driven by a formula on a style property.
parameter: A run-time prompt whose value feeds the query or expressions, letting one report serve many filters.
sub-report: A complete report embedded inside another, with its own query - the building block for composite layouts.
drill-down: A link from a summary element (often a chart) to a more detailed report or view.
BA repository: The Pentaho Server's content store. Published reports live here and run in the Pentaho User Console.
publish: Uploading a finished .prpt from Report Designer to the Pentaho Server so users can run it in the browser.
PUC: Pentaho User Console - the Pentaho Server's browser UI where published reports are browsed, run, and scheduled.
transformation: A data flow you design in PDI (Spoon): steps connected by hops that read, transform, and write data.
